label: PF Backlog 553
title: grooming/approval refreshes + saves the parent epic execution_order
body:
## Why
grooming/approval updated a child's analysis but left the parent epic's saved execution_order stale (or absent).
The user wants grooming to (re)order the epic.

## What
- grooming.reorder_epics(scope, project, item_ids): recompute + SAVE execution_order for the parent epic(s) of
  the given items (read-only compute via core.scheduler.epic_order; write via backlog.set_execution_order).
- Wired into groom, groom_all, decide, decide_all (single reorder for the batch; decide_all suppresses the
  per-item reorder). Results include epics_reordered.

## Verify
- test_scheduler_eligibility.test_grooming_reorders_epic: approving a child sets the epic's execution_order to
  its open children.
